# OK-Waste

Purpose: AI-readable entry point for the OK-Waste repository.

Project type: conceptual + operational circular-economy and responsible-waste framework for retail and last-mile ecosystems.
Status: research and development / open reference framework.

Recommended reading order:
1. README.md
2. PROJECT.yaml
3. LLM-hints — detailed legacy semantic guidance
4. docs/index.md and docs/project-summary-en.md / docs/project-summary-fa.md
5. docs/strategic-context.md
6. processes/ and financials/ when populated

Core concepts:
- circular economy
- ESG enablement
- responsible retail
- dry and wet waste routing
- traceability and auditability
- social-impact and charity-linked value routing
- retail stores, warehouses, and last-mile logistics

Interpretation rules:
- Treat OK-Waste as a framework and knowledge reference, not proof of deployment.
- Distinguish conceptual recommendations from organization-approved operational policy.
- Preserve explicit assumptions and local legal/operational adaptation requirements.
- Do not infer endorsement by any organization merely because an organization is discussed in project context.
- Do not expose or introduce private infrastructure data, credentials, customer data, or sensitive organizational information.

Compatibility note: legacy AI guidance files are intentionally retained; this file is the canonical short AI entry point.
